stories.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Request/Response Contracts
stories.description: Establish strict request and response schemas for facade methods covering clinical trials search and provider detail flows, aligning with existing Pydantic tool models and ensuring consistent structured outputs for downstream tool_router consumption.

stories.title: Implement Facade Error Handling and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Add standardized error handling within evaluate_care_facade to gracefully manage external API failures (ClinicalTrials.gov, NPI registry) and return structured fallback responses without breaking tool execution.

stories.title: Normalize and Aggregate Domain Service Outputs
stories.description: Implement core facade logic to normalize outputs from clinical trials and provider detail services into a unified response format, including field mapping, enrichment, and ordering for LLM consumption.

stories.title: Add Debug Logging for Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Integrate debug_logger into evaluate_care_facade to capture request inputs, service call sequencing, and response outputs for observability and troubleshooting without exposing sensitive data.
